name: Barcs (Hungary)
description: A vertical yellow banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Barcs (a red and green shield with a helm and red mantling) above the name BARCS in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Barcs arms with helm and mantling
